name: Gumroad
gotchas: Reaching /checkout is FLAKY, not structural: on 2026-07-20 it advanced on 5 of 11 stores in one pass, and the failures ('could not reach checkout' at level `detect`) included pages structurally identical to the passes — same single 'I want this!' button, no variants, no price input (verified by hand on daribodrawing). Treat a non-advance as RETRYABLE and re-navigate; do not classify the store as a dead-end on one attempt. NB this is NOT Gumroad-specific — see the cross-platform first-attempt flake documented in bench/README.md; a retry pass fixed it on Gumroad, Big Cartel, Ecwid AND WooCommerce alike.
notes: The 'I want this!' cart drawer needs the in-drawer checkout step; card entry is a standard Stripe Payment Element once reached. Best-evidenced platform in the registry as of 2026-07-20: 5 independent stores reached `fill` with no selector overrides (miapaladini, eproessentials, ellenescapes, sarahraedraws, hdbrooke).

steps.addToCart: Set the price (input[aria-label*=price]) for pay-what-you-want, click 'I want this!', then follow the /checkout link or the cart-drawer 'Checkout'.
steps.payment: Stripe Payment Element via waitStripeCardFrame. Card-number token, then the CVV token into the payment frame immediately after.
